name: Lumenvale
summary: Lumenvale is a pixel-art fantasy MMORPG played in the web browser, with no download required. Players create a hero from one of four classes (Arcanist, Blade Dancer, Guardian or Ranger) and explore the realm of Lumenvale, following a main story line, completing quests, fighting monsters in open-world regions, clearing instanced dungeons with other players and facing world bosses. Heroes progress up to level 100 through a skill grimoire with talents and mutations, a hero skill tree, equipment and crafting, pets and player guilds called Orders. The game is currently in development and in open beta, in Brazilian Portuguese.
